name: Lender draw package index
summary: Before a monthly draw goes to the lender, the project finance lead has an index in the lender’s own order: every required document listed or missing, and every invoice set against the ledger. The lender decides funding; nothing is submitted.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own map of construction work, written from how a project finance team assembles a draw: the lender's checklist as the order of the index, fixed inputs with stated column headers, a plain match of each invoice to the ledger, every gap named with the role to ask, and a finance lead who decides on submission.
